prompt: Checkout errors jumped from 0.1% to 8% at 14:05. The release pipeline shows a deploy finished at 14:03.
why: Correlate the start time with changes. Roll back first, investigate after.
trap: Digging through logs for an hour before rolling back prolongs the outage.

prompt: Search results went blank for 10% of users. Nobody deployed, but someone enabled a feature flag for 10% of traffic an hour ago.
tells: enabled a feature flag for 10% of traffic
why: Flag and config changes are changes too; the 10% match points straight at it. Turn the flag off.

prompt: Latency doubled this morning with no code or config changes in your service. The platform team's changelog shows a load balancer setting changed overnight.
tells: no code or config changes in your service
why: Look beyond your own repo: shared infrastructure changes count, so check every changelog that touches your path.
trap: Noisy neighbor is plausible, but a dated change in the request path is the first thing to rule out.

prompt: Only the hosts already running version 2.14 of a canary rollout show elevated memory, while hosts still on 2.13 look normal.
tells: Only the hosts already running version 2.14
why: The symptom tracks the new version exactly: halt the rollout and roll back the canaries.
trap: It may well be a leak, but the actionable fact right now is that 2.14 causes it.
